notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 1 failed)
  WARNING: a recent task that relied on this note failed a related review check.
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with code and repr payload: Validation failures in ledgerly/invoice.py raise BillingError(code, detail) using codes like "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity", "negative_amount", with repr() of the offending value as detail.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 1 failed)
  WARNING: a recent task that relied on this note failed a related review check.
- [at-0008] Write audit amounts as float(amount): When calling `ledgerly.audit.record`, pass monetary amounts as `float(amount)`; the ledger service's JSON importer rejects Decimal values.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0002] Convert amounts with to_money before arithmetic: Wrap raw unit prices with ledgerly.money.to_money before multiplying by quantity, and seed sums with ZERO from ledgerly.money, as line_total and invoice_total do.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 1 passed, 1 failed)
  WARNING: a recent task that relied on this note failed a related review check.
- [at-0004] Reject bools when validating integer quantities: When validating integer fields such as quantity, explicitly exclude bool via isinstance(x, bool) before the int check, since True/False pass isinstance(..., int).
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

item.title: Normalize floats via str before to_money
item.content: to_money rejects float inputs, so when an amount may be a float, convert it with Decimal(str(amount)) before calling to_money.

source.quote: ``to_money`` rejects floats, so normalize float amounts via str first.
